newsitem.title: FRANCE: TENNIS-AGASSI PULLS OUT OF FRENCH OPEN.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-AGASSI PULLS OUT OF FRENCH OPEN.

text.p: Former world number one Andre Agassi pulled out of the French Open because of a lingering wrist injury, organisers said on Tuesday.
The same injury forced the American to withdraw from the German Open in Hamburg earlier this month.
A losing finalist in the French Open in 1990 and 1991, Agassi has fallen in the world rankings in recent weeks and is currently ranked 28.
He will be replaced in the final men's draw by Frenchman Jerome Golmard.
Agassi is the third leading player to pull out of the French Open. German Boris Becker and American Todd Martin have also withdrawn due to injury.
